newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH PAULIG BUYS MAJORITY OF DANISH OSCAR A/S.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH PAULIG BUYS MAJORITY OF DANISH OSCAR A/S.

text.p: Pimenta Oy, part of Finnish coffee roaster and spice group Paulig Oy, has bought a majority of Danish foodstuff company Oscar A/S, Paulig said in a statement on Friday.
Oscar's net sales last year were 24 million markka and its main market area is Denmark.
"Pimenta also has an option to buy the rest of the shares," Paulig said. It did not give any financial details of the deal.

"The deal will broaden Paulig's product range and strenghten the company's position in the Nordic markets in line with its strategy," it said. Paulig added it was cooperating with Sweden's Nordfalks AB. The two jointly own Danish spice firm Danske Krydderier A/S.
Pimenta's annual net sales were about 100 million markka, it said.
